name: Topolograph Docker
description: Dockerized OSPF/IS-IS topology visualization and what-if analysis tool. Builds network topology from LSDB data, calculates shortest paths, and simulates link/node failures. Includes MCP server for LLM/AI agent integration.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Run your local copy of Topolograph inside your on-premises network using the docker image. The Docker setup includes an MCP server that enables AI agents and Large Language Models to interact with the Topolograph API.

eval_notes: Unique what-if failure simulation for OSPF/IS-IS topologies with MCP server for AI agent integration. Simulates link/router shutdown and shows traffic flow changes. Directly supports agentic network analysis use cases. Supports multi-vendor devices (Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Nokia, Huawei).
